title: PlaySlot: Learning Inverse Latent Dynamics for Controllable Object-Centric Video Prediction and Planning
summary: PlaySlot is an object-centric video prediction model that infers object slots and latent actions from unlabeled videos. It can generate several controllable futures, and its inferred actions let robots learn behaviors sample-efficiently from unlabeled demonstrations.
